description: This file contains selector functions for accessing user preferences and configuration settings within the Mattermost Redux state, including theme preferences, display settings, feature flags, and other user-specific options.

methods.name: getMyPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's preferences from the global state.

methods.name: getUserPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves preferences for a specific user by userID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a preference value for a given category and name, with optional default and preferences override.

methods.name: getFromPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves a preference value directly from a preferences object.

methods.name: getBool
methods.description: Gets a boolean preference value.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Gets an integer preference value.

methods.name: makeGetCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to get preferences in a specific category.

methods.name: makeGetUserCategory
methods.description: Creates a selector to get user-specific preferences in a category.

methods.name: getTeammateNameDisplaySetting
methods.description: Determines the display setting for teammate names based on config, preferences, and license.

methods.name: getThemePreferences
methods.description: Creates a selector for theme-related preferences.

methods.name: getTheme
methods.description: Retrieves the current theme, considering user preferences and defaults.

methods.name: makeGetStyleFromTheme
methods.description: Creates a function to generate styles from a theme.

methods.name: shouldShowJoinLeaveMessages
methods.description: Determines if join/leave messages should be shown based on config.

methods.name: shouldShowUnreadsCategory
methods.description: Checks if unreads should be grouped separately in the sidebar.

methods.name: getUnreadScrollPositionPreference
methods.description: Gets the user's preference for unread scroll position.

methods.name: getCollapsedThreadsPreference
methods.description: Gets the user's preference for collapsed threads.

methods.name: getCollapsedThreadsPreferenceFromPreferences
methods.description: Gets collapsed threads preference from user preferences.

methods.name: isCollapsedThreadsAllowed
methods.description: Checks if collapsed threads are allowed based on config.

methods.name: isCollapsedThreadsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if collapsed threads are enabled for current user and config.

methods.name: isCollapsedThreadsEnabledForUser
methods.description: Checks if collapsed threads are enabled for a specific user.

methods.name: isGroupChannelManuallyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a group channel is manually visible.

methods.name: isCustomGroupsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if custom groups are enabled in config.

methods.name: getIsOnboardingFlowEnabled
methods.description: Checks if onboarding flow is enabled.

methods.name: getHasDismissedSystemConsoleLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if the user has dismissed the system console limit message.

methods.name: syncedDraftsAreAllowed
methods.description: Checks if synced drafts are allowed by config.

methods.name: syncedDraftsAreAllowedAndEnabled
methods.description: Checks if synced drafts are allowed and enabled for user.

methods.name: getVisibleDmGmLimit
methods.description: Gets the limit for visible DMs and GMs.

methods.name: onboardingTourTipsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if onboarding tour tips are enabled via feature flag.

methods.name: moveThreadsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if move threads feature is enabled via feature flag and license.

methods.name: streamlinedMarketplaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if streamlined marketplace feature is enabled via feature flag.

methods.name: getOverageBannerPreferences
methods.description: Selector for overage banner preferences.

methods.name: getPostHistoryLimitBannerPreferences
methods.description: Selector for post history limit banner preferences.
